title.narrative: UNICEF supported emergency preparedness, response, and resilience across Pacific Island countries through coordination, anticipatory action, and prepositioning supplies at strategic locations. Partnering with IFRC, UNICEF trained over 18 national Red Cross societies and government staff on emergency preparedness. Supplies are prepositioned in key locations, including Brisbane, Fiji, and Samoa. In Vanuatu, coordinated efforts improved cyclone readiness, providing over 38,000 people with safe water and sanitation. Climate resilience was integrated into water safety planning and school reconstruction in Vanuatu. In Kiribati as well as in Solomon Islands, UNICEF is finalising the WASH Climate Rationale to address climate hazards. ;Key efforts include deploying solar desalination units with MISE, promoting rainwater harvesting, and developing sanitation technologies with MLPID to safeguard freshwater resources.
